entries.title: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders: $1B to protect essential services
entries.summary: OpenAI introduces Daybreak for Frontline Defenders. A $1 billion commitment expands access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services.

entries.title: Playco cut manual fixes 50% prototyping games with GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: Using GPT-6 Astra, Playco built three themed game prototypes from one grey box foundation and reported 50% fewer manual fixes than with the previous model.

entries.title: Legora reviewed 41 documents in minutes with GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 documents in minutes, find all four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in this financial-review workflow.

entries.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
entries.summary: Introducing GPT-6 Astra, our most intelligent and aligned model yet, with state-of-the-art capabilities across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science.

entries.title: Safety overview: GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: GPT-6 Astra is our most capable broadly deployed model and our first to reach the Critical level of cybersecurity capability under our Preparedness Framework.

entries.title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
entries.summary: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more. It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.

entries.title: How AI-native companies turn workflows into operating capability
entries.summary: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.

entries.title: Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
entries.summary: Astra is the first OpenAI model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, with stronger safeguards for release.

entries.title: Healthcare organizations can now connect EHR and additional industry data to ChatGPT
entries.summary: ChatGPT can now connect to trusted healthcare data, helping clinicians securely access patient context, medical research, and more.

entries.title: How law firm Gilbert + Tobin governs and scales AI with OpenAI
entries.summary: See how Gilbert + Tobin combines CEO-led commitment, rigorous governance, and human accountability to scale ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex across the firm.

entries.title: OpenAI supports California’s bill to advance youth AI safety
entries.summary: OpenAI supports California SB 1119, advancing strong, age-appropriate AI safeguards for teens while preserving opportunities to learn, create, and explore.

entries.title: Polimill builds Japan's next-generation public AI infrastructure
entries.summary: Polimill uses OpenAI GPT models and Codex to help municipalities search and use administrative knowledge while accelerating development.

entries.title: A milestone in expanding access to AI
entries.summary: ChatGPT Ads reaches $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate and expands globally, supporting broader access to AI through free and affordable options.

entries.title: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX
entries.summary: Our decision to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX.

entries.title: Supporting Thailand’s next generation of AI startups
entries.summary: OpenAI and Thailand’s MHESI launch an eight-week accelerator helping 10 health, wellness, and education startups turn AI prototypes into trusted products.

entries.title: Better answers, broader thinking: What students gain from ChatGPT and critical-thinking training
entries.summary: A randomized study of more than 1,000 students examines ChatGPT, critical thinking, originality, and student performance on a real-world university assignment.

entries.title: Expanding OpenAI’s presence in Brazil
entries.summary: OpenAI is expanding its presence in Brazil, deepening engagement with developers, businesses, and communities to support AI adoption across the country.

entries.title: Learning never stops: How AI makes learning continuous
entries.summary: OpenAI’s new report explores how students and educators use ChatGPT to make learning more continuous, with support that extends beyond the classroom.

entries.title: Bringing ChatGPT for Teachers to more U.S. school districts
entries.summary: ChatGPT for Teachers is expanding to 55 U.S. school systems, bringing secure AI tools, training, and support to over 100,000 more educators and staff.

entries.title: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
entries.summary: OpenAI shares findings from the Hugging Face security incident and the steps we’re taking to strengthen AI model security, monitoring, and alignment.

entries.title: How loveholidays is making everyone a builder with Codex
entries.summary: Discover how loveholidays uses OpenAI Codex to make software development accessible across the business, helping teams turn ideas into products faster.

entries.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
entries.summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.

entries.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
entries.summary: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.

entries.title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
entries.summary: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West.

entries.title: Introducing the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex
entries.summary: Use the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex to analyze workspace usage, manage members and permissions, adjust limits, and act on admin requests.
